title: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), any PEM user can run the pem.send_webhook() function, which runs with elevated…
description: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), any PEM user could previously invoke the pem.send_webhook() function, which operates with elevated privileges to queue payloads for configured webhooks. This allowed users to send forged notifications using stored authentication tokens or certificates of those webhooks. Starting from PEM version 10.6.1, direct calls to this function by PEM login roles are blocked, and webhook notifications are sent only through internal PEM mechanisms.
